steps.title: Download Astro
steps.body: A complete browser — no BrowserOS, no toolchain, nothing to build. About 231 MB, Apple silicon.

steps.title: Drag Astro to Applications
steps.body: Signed and notarized, so it opens normally — no right-click trick, no Terminal.

steps.title: Keep BrowserOS or Astro, not both
steps.body: They share a bundle ID, so they share a profile — and BrowserOS deletes Astro's agent from it.
steps.verifierLabel: Only one of the two is installed

steps.title: Let the search engine download
steps.body: About 150 MB on your first search. Every search after that runs on your own machine.

expect.prompt: In the Astro browser window, has a search finished and produced results on the page, rather than still sitting on an empty or loading composer?

hints: Give the first search a few minutes — the engine downloads silently before anything appears.
If the page is still empty after that, search again; only the first search has to download anything.

steps.title: Choose where answers come from
steps.body: Search already works without this. Add a Claude, Codex, Copilot or Ollama route for answers.
steps.verifierLabel: A model is selected in Settings

setupSteps.title: Install Git
setupSteps.body: Run the installer, then reopen PowerShell.
setupSteps.verifierLabel: Git responds with a version number

setupSteps.title: Install Node LTS
setupSteps.body: Run the LTS installer, then reopen PowerShell.
setupSteps.verifierLabel: Node responds with a version number

steps.title: Install BrowserOS
steps.body: Astro drives this browser; you keep both apps. SmartScreen: pick More info, then Run anyway.

steps.title: Check Git and Node
steps.body: Node 22+ required. An older Node earlier in PATH is the usual cause of a failed setup.
steps.verifierLabel: Git works and Node is 22 or newer

steps.title: Install Bun 1.3.6
steps.body: The project rejects npm, pnpm and yarn outright; the version is pinned.

expect.prompt: In the shell, does the Bun installer report that Bun v1.3.6 was installed successfully?

hints: The installer only adds bun to PATH for new sessions — open a fresh PowerShell before using it.
It warns if another bun.exe is already earlier in PATH; that one still wins until you reorder it.

steps.title: Install Go
steps.body: Go builds Astro's dev orchestrator. Run the installer, then reopen PowerShell.

steps.title: Install Lima
steps.body: The dev command exits if limactl is missing, even though nothing in the run uses it.

steps.title: Get Astro
steps.command:
cd ~
if [ ! -d Astro/.git ]; then
git clone https://github.com/Blueturboguy07/Astro.git
fi
cd Astro
git checkout 32eb1dc7bb8ed29d8eb5aeac049c4f7972f1c257
cd packages/browseros-agent

steps.title: Copy the env file, edit one line
steps.body: Then open .env.development and point BROWSEROS_BINARY at your BrowserOS .exe.
steps.verifierLabel: BROWSEROS_BINARY points at your BrowserOS install

expect.prompt: In the shell, has `bun run dev:setup` finished with the line "Setup ready" and no error after it?

hints: Ending in "No schema found" means GRAPHQL_SCHEMA_PATH is still set in .env.development.
Setup runs bun install --frozen-lockfile first; if that refuses, check bun --version is 1.3.6.

steps.title: Run Astro
steps.body: Keep PowerShell open. A browser window opens on Astro's new tab.

expect.prompt: Has a browser window opened on Astro's new tab — the Astro composer — rather than only the shell still printing output?

hints: "Lima is not installed" means limactl is not on PATH; dev:watch checks for it before anything starts.
If no window appears, BROWSEROS_BINARY in .env.development is probably still the macOS path.

steps.title: Let the search engine download
steps.body: About 150 MB, once. Every search after that runs on your own machine.

expect.prompt: In the Astro browser window, has a search finished and produced results on the page, rather than still sitting on an empty or loading composer?

hints: Give the first search a few minutes — the engine downloads silently before anything appears.
If the page is still empty after that, search again; only the first search has to download anything.

steps.title: Choose where answers come from
steps.body: Search already works without this. Add a Claude, Codex, Copilot or Ollama route for answers.
steps.verifierLabel: A model is selected in Settings

steps.title: Coming back later
steps.body: Next time: open a terminal, cd ~/Astro/packages/browseros-agent, then bun run dev:watch.
steps.verifierLabel: You know the one command that reopens Astro
